# Aurora Free 3D Games

Aurora Game Center now has a dedicated catalog for free/open-source 3D games.

The catalog is intentionally license-aware. Chimera II OS may stage or build projects whose source code and assets are redistributable under compatible licenses, while commercial/proprietary game data remains outside the image.

Initial catalog includes SuperTuxKart, Luanti, Xonotic, Red Eclipse, Unvanquished, The Dark Mod, Veloren, Rigs of Rods, FlightGear, Stunt Rally, TORCS, Lugaru, SuperTuxWorld and Cubyz.

The catalog is extensible rather than claiming to contain every 3D game on the Internet. Web discovery can be used to refresh the registry, but unverified binaries and copyrighted commercial game data are not automatically downloaded into the OS.

References:
- SuperTuxKart is GPL and provides a source repository. 
- Luanti is an open-source voxel game engine.
- Lugaru is documented as fully free, with GPL code and CC BY-SA assets.
- Cubyz is documented as a GPLv3 3D voxel sandbox.
